siteConfig.name: AKP Welfare Foundation
siteConfig.description: AKP Welfare Foundation is dedicated to empowering underprivileged communities through education, nutrition, healthcare, and sustainable development programs across India.

hero.description: AKP Welfare Foundation empowers underprivileged communities through education, nutrition, healthcare, and sustainable development programs across India.

programsSection.subtitle: What We Do
programsSection.title: Our Programs
programsSection.description: We run impactful programs that create lasting change in the lives of those who need it most.

programs.title: Education Support
programs.shortDescription: Providing quality education and scholarships to underprivileged children, ensuring no child is left behind.
programs.fullDescription: Our Education Support program provides comprehensive learning opportunities including school supplies, scholarships, after-school tutoring, digital literacy programs, and mentorship.

programs.title: Food Distribution
programs.shortDescription: Fighting hunger by providing nutritious meals and food supplies to families in need across communities.
programs.fullDescription: Our Food Distribution program operates community kitchens and mobile food distribution units that serve nutritious meals daily.

programs.title: Medical Camps
programs.shortDescription: Organizing free medical camps and health awareness programs in rural and underserved areas.
programs.fullDescription: Our Medical Camps program brings quality healthcare to doorsteps of communities that lack access.

programs.title: Community Welfare
programs.shortDescription: Building stronger communities through skill development, women empowerment, and infrastructure projects.
programs.fullDescription: Our Community Welfare program focuses on holistic development including skill training workshops, women self-help groups, clean water initiatives.

storiesSection.subtitle: Real Impact
storiesSection.title: Stories of Change
storiesSection.description: Every donation, every volunteer hour creates ripples of change. Here are some stories that inspire us.

stories.title: From Street to School: Riya's Journey
stories.excerpt: Riya was selling flowers at traffic signals before AKP Foundation stepped in. Today, she tops her class and dreams of becoming a doctor.

stories.title: A Village Transformed by Clean Water
stories.excerpt: Sundarpura village had no clean drinking water. Our community well project now serves 500 families with safe, clean water every day.

stories.title: Feeding Hope: The Community Kitchen Story
stories.excerpt: Our Bangalore community kitchen started with 50 meals a day. Today it serves 2,000 nutritious meals daily to those in need.

donationSection.subtitle: Make a Difference
donationSection.title: Your Donation Matters
donationSection.description: Every rupee you donate directly impacts lives. Choose an amount and help us create lasting change.
donationSection.footerNote: Secure payment powered by Razorpay. Tax deductible under 80G.

volunteerCTA.subtitle: Join Our Mission
volunteerCTA.title: Become a Volunteer & Make an Impact
volunteerCTA.description: Join thousands of passionate individuals who are making a difference. Whether you can spare a few hours or a few days, your skills and time can transform lives.

benefits.text: Flexible schedules - weekdays, weekends, or both

teamMembers.name: Arun Kumar Patel
teamMembers.bio: With over 20 years of social work experience, Arun founded AKP Welfare Foundation with a vision to create lasting change in underserved communities.

teamMembers.name: Dr. Priya Sharma
teamMembers.bio: A public health expert who oversees all welfare programs and ensures maximum impact in every community we serve.

teamMembers.name: Rajesh Menon
teamMembers.bio: Rajesh brings 15 years of NGO management experience, ensuring smooth execution of all field operations.

teamMembers.name: Sneha Gupta
teamMembers.bio: Sneha manages our network of 5,000+ volunteers and drives community engagement across all programs.

milestones.description: AKP Welfare Foundation was registered with a mission to serve underprivileged communities.

milestones.description: Launched our food distribution program, serving 1,000 meals in the first month.

milestones.title: COVID Relief
milestones.description: Provided emergency relief to 10,000+ families during the pandemic.

milestones.title: Education Centers
milestones.description: Opened 50 community learning centers across 3 states.
